estimates.rationale: Foundational: bootstraps schema, layering (boundary/service/repository/models), migration, unique (sku,location) constraint, plus first form + index/detail UI with empty/validation states.
Reuses FP1 layers; adds adjust service logic (never-below-zero, timestamp+actor) and optimistic in-place SPA update with inline rejection.
New supplier-attributed inbound event: receipt form, service to increment stock at a location, confirmation flow; modest new domain surface on existing layers.
Outbound pick with write-time overcommit enforcement (R2): pick form, drawdown service with shortfall rejection, inline error UI naming the shortfall.
Primarily a read/aggregation slice: SKU detail view listing multiple location rows; leans on existing persistence, limited new write logic.
